import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int capacity, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 15000;
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static long totalCost = 0;
    static long[] dist = new long[10000];
    static int[] p = new int[10000];
    static int[] pe = new int[10000];
    static int[] inQueue = new int[10000];

    static int n, m, k, c, d;
    static int source = 9998;
    static int sink = 9999;

    static void addEdge(int x, int y, int cap, int cost) {
        adj[x].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(y, cap, 0, cost));
        adj[y].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(x, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static void sendRebels() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(p, -1);
        Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, 0);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        inQueue[source] = 1;
        int current = sink;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int k = q.poll();
            inQueue[k] = 0;
            for (int edgeIdx : adj[k]) {
                Edge e = edges.get(edgeIdx);
                if (e.capacity - e.flow == 0) continue;
                int cost = e.cost;
                int y = e.to;
                if (dist[y] > dist[k] + cost) {
                    dist[y] = dist[k] + cost;
                    p[y] = k;
                    pe[y] = edgeIdx;
                    if (inQueue[y] == 0) {
                        inQueue[y] = 1;
                        q.offer(y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int curNode = current;
        while (curNode != source) {
            int edgeIdx = pe[curNode];
            edges.get(edgeIdx).flow++;
            edges.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow--;
            curNode = p[curNode];
        }
        totalCost += dist[sink];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        int[] pArr = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            x--;
            addEdge(source, x, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 101; i++) {
            addEdge((i - 1) * n, sink, k, (i - 1) * c);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int iLevel = 1; iLevel <= 100; iLevel++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    addEdge(x + (iLevel - 1) * n, y + (iLevel - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
                    addEdge(y + (iLevel - 1) * n, x + (iLevel - 1) * n + n, 1, d * ((j - 1) * 2 + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int iNode = 1; iNode <= n; iNode++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 100; j++) {
                addEdge(iNode - 1 + (j - 1) * n, iNode - 1 + (j - 1) * n + n, k, 0);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            sendRebels();
        }

        System.out.println(totalCost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
